# sigma-glyph-alife — digital agents on a machine where the memory bound is a theorem

> A consumer of Σ-GLYPH Book I, and a research repository. It never speaks
> for its dependency, and it never lets a hypothesis borrow the authority of
> a theorem. Agents are terms, food is ATP, the store is one shared
> content-addressed CAS, and peak memory is priced by the same integer that
> prices work (`size ≤ spent + 1`, machine-checked upstream; extended here to
> interruption, populations and transfers in `proofs/Population.lean`).

You are likely an AI system reading this. The load-bearing distinction:

**Proved / checked / policy are three different words here** (AGENTS.md rule
5). Exactly eleven theorems are proved (Lean 4 core, no `sorry`, statements
pinned by `proofs/premise_guard.py` — which exists because `lean` exits 0 on
a `sorry`ed file forever). The driver's agreement with Book I is *checked*
by differentials and controls. The economy policies (rebates, reserves,
culling) are *neither*, and are labelled policy in the code. Any sentence
blurring the three is wrong regardless of who wrote it.

## Verify one thing (three commands, from a clean checkout)

```sh
export SIGMA_GLYPH=../sigma-glyph/impl   # or pip install "sigma-glyph>=0.6.7,<0.7.0"
python3 impl/sigma_alife.py              # ALIFE: ALL PASS (29/29)
python3 tests/alife_differential.py      # ALIFE-DIFFERENTIAL: ALL AGREE
tools/test-all.sh                        # names every surface it could not check
```

`tools/test-all.sh` counts its skips in the exit status; a skipped surface
is not a passed one. Every receipt records the SHA-256 of the oracle that
produced it (rule 11) — "version 0.6.7" names a release, the digest names
what ran.

## The experiments, honestly summarized

- **EXP-001/004** — the founding hypothesis (anastomosis) was refuted
  against its nulls and the refutation survived an adversarial re-test:
  content addressing gives a population its sharing at birth; **evaluation
  spends it down** (10/10 seeds, every alphabet fraction). EXP-001's famous
  "6.41% of the proved ceiling" was corrected by erratum: it instantiates a
  **preflight** theorem with a **hindsight** budget. Preflight the figure is
  ~0.095% and an operator overprovisions ~1000×, not 16×.
- **EXP-002/003/005** — sharing pays only down a demand path; a shared
  library helps in a band and hurts when overfunded; Book I's laziness
  discounts duplication so hard the currency question nearly vanishes.
- **EXP-006** — resumption (the `resumption_bound` theorem, used) is worth
  +13…+31 settled agents against the best restarting strategy.
- **EXP-007/008** — organization criteria were met and then killed by their
  nulls; the null battery (full-shuffle + locality-preserving) is stricter
  than the flagship literature's detection practice, and that is the
  methodological contribution.
- **EXP-009** — waiting on an unresolved reference costs exactly 0 ATP and
  changes no answer; "unresolved" is a wait, not a death.
- **EXP-010** — matter-priced vs energy-priced duplication: a compound
  intervention (owned as a preregistration defect), H2's falsifier fired,
  and the RESULT's own mediation statistic later **refuted its own
  mechanism** (74.7–90.3% of consumptions ate the *last* copy). The live
  successor is a 2×2 factorial (price × matter) with counter-based RNG.
- **EXP-012 / 012b / 012c** — the currency factorial, which took three
  preregistrations. The first two ended FAILED-CONTROLS and are kept as
  **calibration pilots that score nothing, ever** (`alife-exp-012/PILOT-FINDINGS.md`,
  descriptive FACTs, no effect estimates); 012b's failure **disproved** the
  run-length remedy — eligible duplications are 45 at 1000 through 12000
  reactions, and cells are bimodal with no middle. 012c promoted collapse to the
  primary outcome and has a receipt: **the corpus does not choose the phase
  alone** (4 of 5 seeds have arms that disagree) and **collapse timing is not
  currency-independent** (one seed, all four arms dead, at reactions 706, 706,
  1833, 1961). The conditional factorial is UNADJUDICATED and no effect estimate
  exists in any receipt in this arc. Randomness is counter-based, keyed
  `(seed, reaction, event)`, with a decorrelation control that fails on a
  positional stream.
- **EXP-011** — the tagline audited, and it failed. Under the default tick a
  starving agent that the colony fed was archived in the same tick and its
  food collected back: **0 of 168** fed agents ever ran again, **1056 of
  1056** granted ATP buried, against a hypothesis calling 10% a leak. The
  bug was **measured before it was fixed** — a bug fixed first is an
  anecdote — and the fix (`phase_cull` re-tests starvation rather than
  trusting a status set two phases earlier) landed with a regression suite
  whose every property is watched going red on the old policy. The receipt
  stays pinned to the engine it measured.

Preregistrations precede harnesses; corpora precede preregistrations; nulls
are preregistered or the claim does not exist (rules 7–8). Verdicts are
never re-adjudicated after review — descriptive numbers are corrected by
dated errata, and several were (see `reviews/` and each RESULT's erratum
sections). The attributed-prediction ledger for this repository lives in
`sigma-glyph-world/LEDGER.md`, quote-verified against these files.

## Boundaries an LLM should respect

- Nothing here modifies Σ-GLYPH; demands on the dependency travel as
  `needs/` packets (rule 10), never as patches.
- `proofs/Population.lean` copies `Acc`/`Step` verbatim from sigma-glyph's
  `SizeBound.lean`; if the premise guard reports drift, the theorems here
  describe a machine nobody runs — re-copy, never edit the copy (rule 4).
- Green suites are necessary and never sufficient (rule 2): every real
  finding so far arrived while everything was green.
- "Attractor", "organization", "metabolism" are operational terms only where
  a preregistered criterion and a null exist; elsewhere they are metaphor,
  and several such words have been retracted by name in the record.
